# Covariant bounded input beside nominal contexts

Authored variants retain `<T extends Mark> void write(Context, String,
List<? extends T>)`. The recursive carrier validator owns complete declarations,
variance, Object carrier bounds and the sole interface-bounded method formal.
The raw original invocation preserves the actual list, every callback and store.

All 104 fresh JVM cases run twice through direct, explicitly typed, reflection
and method-handle callers. The frozen observer checks mutable, immutable,
array-backed and poison lists, exact list identity, index/value capture, store
callbacks, partial mutation, null/wrong inputs and exception identity. Every
original declaration, metadata record, Exceptions attribute and source helper
role is audited after compiling all generated Java. Same-Code metadata controls
and independently wrong implementations must fail. No private app material is
used or executed.
